[[Pagodon]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}} |species=[[Human]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Where to?|The pilot greets the Mandalorian|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''speeder pilot''' worked with a [[Kubaz]] [[Unidentified Kubaz ferryman|ferryman]] to transport customers on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Pagodon]] with [[Unidentified landspeeder (Pagodon)|his landspeeder]]. In [[9 ABY]], he drove a [[bounty hunter]] known as [[Din Djarin]] and his [[The Fledgling Mythrol|bounty]] across the ice to Djarin's [[Razor Crest|gunship]]. After dropping off the pair and driving away, the driver was [[Death|killed]] by a [[ravinak]] which broke the ice beneath the [[pilot]]'s [[landspeeder]] and dragged it into the [[water]] below. ==Biography== {{Quote|You're looking for ravinaks right?'''"
"'''It's clear right now, but be careful near the port. Everyone dumps their Gray Holds out. They think the whole entire planet is their personal sink pit.|The Mythrol passenger and the pilot discuss ravinaks|}} [[File:Speeder_Pilot_The_Mandalorian.png|thumb|left|250px|The pilot transported the Mandalorian and the Mythrol]] A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] worked as a [[speeder]] [[pilot]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] [[Pagodon]] shortly after the fall of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He worked with a [[Kubaz]] [[Unidentified Kubaz ferryman|ferryman]] to get customers who would pay for transport. In [[9 ABY]], the ferryman summoned the [[pilot]] by playing a [[flute]] as a [[bounty hunter]] known as [[Din Djarin]] was seeking to return to his [[starship]] with a [[Mythrol]] [[The Fledgling Mythrol|prisoner]]. The [[pilot]] agreed to the fare and drove the pair across ice fields in his [[landspeeder]], checking ahead for [[ravinak]]s and warning them to watch out for the dangerous creatures. After dropping the [[Mandalorian]] and his [[bounty]] off at the [[gunship]] ''[[Razor Crest]]'', the human piloted his [[speeder]] away, only to be [[Death|killed]] when a ravinak shattered the ice beneath his vehicle and pulled it into the [[water]]s below. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Hey, it's time to go. Let's settle up.|The pilot asks for payment|}} The pilot had fair skin, [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s and brown [[hair]]. ==Equipment== The pilot drove a red landspeeder that was in a state of disrepair by the time of his final trip across the ice fields. He wore a brown [[Clothing|coat]] with a fur lined hood and a pair of [[goggles]] and used a pair of [[binoculars]] to check for ravinaks. ==Behind the scenes== The speeder pilot appeared in the [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|first episode]] of the [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[November 12]], 2019.{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}} He was portrayed by [[Brian Posehn]]. ==Appearances== *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}} {{1st}} *''[[The Mandalorian: Season 1: Volume 1]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian: The Manga]]'' *[[The Mandalorian 1|''The Mandalorian'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{DisneyGallery|Connections}} *[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian: Guide to Season One|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'': Guide to Season One]] {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Piloto humano de deslizador no identificado |fr=Pilote de landspeeder non-identifié |ja=名称不明の人間のスピーダー・パイロット |ka=სპიდერის უცნობი პილოტი ადამიანი |pl=Pilot śmigacza }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Pilots]]
